notes: kb/Work PB5373 class 1, recorded 2026-11-14 (wave 20262028 A). §1985:XIV.3.6.4 GR5: "The effect of having special control characters within the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is undefined." Closed on the mechanical arm undefined-in-rule (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 8, DRV-1985-GR-XIV.3.6.4-5, signed claude: 2026-11-12). The determination docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 3 states for 2002 B.2 item 52 holds at every edition: MessageControlSession.Send stores the portion's characters unchanged and McsStore.Transmit writes a message's segments to the device file as they were sent, so control characters are carried as data. No test: a rule whose result is undefined has no expected value.
